finding.title: The code assumes that the input array `arr` contains non-negative integers. If the array contains negative integers, the code will attempt to access out-of-bounds memory in the `count` array.
The code does not check if the `malloc` calls succeed. If memory allocation fails, the program will continue to execute, leading to undefined behavior.
Although not directly applicable in this code, it's a good practice to set pointers to `NULL` after freeing them to prevent accidental use.

scan_patch.message: Expression 'range' can have a negative value. That is converted to an unsigned value and used in an unsigned calculation.
